name: realtimex-mailkeeper
description: To start, ask this workspace's chat to “set up MailKeeper.” Then each inbox is kept tidy by its own contract, on a schedule or when you ask.

api_routes.description: Read a workspace's MailKeeper profile: inboxes and their contract state, settings, approved rules and recent runs.
List inbox names from the user's Himalaya email settings as options for Inboxes. Never returns hosts, addresses or secrets.
Record a finite run receipt (per-inbox outcome, confirmed moves, suggestions, urgent items), including after workspace deactivation.
Approve a suggested rule for one inbox so scheduled runs may apply it. Human-only.
Return an approved rule to the suggestions. Human-only.
Undo runs in the workspace chat, where the inbox credentials are available; this route answers MAILKEEPER_TERMINAL_REQUIRED with the next step.
Re-provision the maintenance thread, any missing inbox contract (existing contracts are never overwritten) and the managed heartbeat task.

configSchema.label: Mode ceiling
configSchema.description: Highest mode any workspace may use. Set once, globally.

options.label: Label only (move to Auto/* folders, never leave the inbox)

configSchema.label: Auto folder prefix
configSchema.description: Folder prefix for audit-trail moves, e.g. Auto/Newsletters.

configSchema.label: Protected sender domains
configSchema.description: Sender domains no rule may ever touch. Applies to every workspace.

configSchema.label: Run receipt retention (days)
configSchema.description: How long run receipts (and undo) are kept.

configSchema.label: Inboxes
configSchema.description: Inboxes this workspace looks after, each with its own contract in mailboxes/. To add one, ask the agent in this workspace's chat to “add an inbox to MailKeeper,” then reopen this dialog and tick it.

configSchema.label: Maintenance agent
configSchema.description: Runs MailKeeper's scheduled checks. When you chat, the agent selected in that chat does the work under the same contracts.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.description: Optional. Empty means the agent's default model.

configSchema.label: Reasoning effort
configSchema.description: Optional. Applies when a model is selected; otherwise the agent's default is used.

configSchema.label: Schedule
configSchema.description: Scheduled runs follow this workspace's heartbeat: its timezone, active hours and pause.

options.label: Manual
options.description: Runs only when you ask in this workspace's chat.

configSchema.label: Mode
configSchema.description: The most any inbox in this workspace may do on its own. Each inbox's contract can be stricter.

configSchema.label: Aggressiveness
configSchema.description: The most any inbox may allow. Contracts can be stricter.

configSchema.label: Age threshold (days)
configSchema.description: Starting value for new inbox contracts. Each contract can set its own.

configSchema.label: VIP senders
configSchema.description: Never touched in any inbox. Add inbox-specific senders in that inbox's contract.
